meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让配音和背景音乐不再互相盖住,把音量、淡化与效果调到刚好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频旁白总被背景音乐压住,或需要给多条音轨统一调音。
copy.tagline_en: Balance voiceover against music and shape fades, ducking and effects per track.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover keeps getting buried by the music and you need it fixed.

howto.what: 当你已在 HyperFrames 合成里放好音频,Claude 会给它们混音:淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道增益、音量自动化、人声闪避,以及 EQ、压缩、混响等效果链;还会按症状推荐预设。
howto.when: 当你已把音频放进 HyperFrames 合成、需要做混音(如淡化、音量、闪避等)时触发。找或生成 BGM、音效、旁白请用 /media-use;剪辑时序用 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给旁白下的音乐床做人声闪避,先把旁白片段编组再闪避。
say.note: 闪避设置会写到音乐床元素上。

say.text: 把这条人声轨 200Hz 的轰隆压一压,再提亮点清晰度。
say.note: 会在轨道上挂 EQ 效果链。

say.text: 这条轨淡入 2 秒、淡出 3 秒,再画一条音量自动化。
say.note: 会写入淡化与自动化包络。

howto.what_en: Once audio is already placed in a HyperFrames composition, Claude mixes it: fades, crossfades, track gain, volume automation, voiceover carve, and effect chains like EQ, compression, reverb. It also picks presets by symptom.
howto.when_en: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs mixing: fades, volume, ducking, effect chains. Sourcing or generating audio is /media-use; clip timing is /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Carve the music bed against the voiceover, and group the voice clips first.
say_en.note: Writes carve settings onto the bed element.

say_en.text: Tame the 200 Hz boominess on this voice track, then add clarity.
say_en.note: Adds an EQ chain to the track.

say_en.text: Fade this track in over 2s, out over 3s, and draw a volume envelope.
say_en.note: Writes fades and an automation lane.
